paper_title: Graph Neural Network Approach to Semantic Type Detection in Tables
caption: The macro f-score of GAIT_{GAT} and RECA on Semtab dataset, for High, Medium, and Low-frequency classes.
model_annotation: The bar chart compares the macro f-score of two models, GAIT$_{\text{GAT}}$ (orange bars) and RECA (light pink bars), on the Semtab dataset across three frequency categories: High, Medium, and Low. The vertical axis represents the Macro f-score, ranging from 0 to 1 with major gridlines at intervals of 0.1. For the High-frequency class, GAIT$_{\text{GAT}}$ achieves a score of 0.877, while RECA scores 0.837. In the Medium-frequency class, GAIT$_{\text{GAT}}$ scores 0.609 and RECA scores 0.538. For the Low-frequency class, GAIT$_{\text{GAT}}$ achieves a score of 0.224, and RECA scores 0.114. The legend below the chart identifies the two models with their corresponding colors. The chart clearly shows that GAIT$_{\text{GAT}}$ outperforms RECA in all three frequency categories, with the performance gap being most pronounced in the Low-frequency class.
